title: Typewriter and Harbor
author: Jude Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Iversen, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
